summary: Kootenai NF tower site in Lincoln County, Montana; a 1930s pole L-4 tower, gone by both firelookout.com and the FFLA list. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com and the FFLA list both mark it gone; no removal date is given

events.note: Firelookout.com gives only the decade, 1930s, for a pole L-4 tower; no exact build year is given
Both sources mark the tower gone; no date or cause given

evidence.supports: Kootenai National Forest is the agency
1930s decade; pole L-4 tower at south end below summit; gone
evidence.quote: 1930s: pole L-4 tower at south end below summit. Gone.

notes_for_editor: Two terse sources, which agree. Firelookout.com gives the 1930s decade, a pole L-4 tower at the south end below the summit, gone, elevation and location; the FFLA list gives coordinates, type Tower and status Gone. Searches for Bunker Hill returned Washington lookouts (Okanogan, Skamania, Pasayten) and a California one; none is the Montana site and none was used. Brief record checks out: Lincoln County, coordinates match the FFLA list, tower kind, gone status. Nothing on staffing, fires, access or the site today. A Kootenai NF history or local newspaper source would be needed for a fuller story.
